fact.box: TSX-listed spot bitcoin ETFs, in any account (TFSA, RRSP or non-registered)
fact.claim: Fidelity Advantage Bitcoin ETF (FBTC) charges a 0.32% management fee and Purpose Bitcoin ETF (BTCC) charges 1.00%, so on $10,000 the difference is about $68 a year. These are management fees only. The full MER each fund reports is higher because it adds operating costs and taxes, so the real gap can be a little different. Fees can change, so check each fund's current fund facts before buying.
